backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with storage and authorization mixins plus all core data types for users, posts, polls, messages, groups, notifications, analytics, and civic features.
feature_evidence.json: Structured feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists concise summaries of various frontend components, pages, hooks, and styles with their purposes and key behaviors.
frontend/ANDROID_BRANDING_ASSETS.md: Documentation describing required Android branding assets and how they are used to generate native app resources.
frontend/ANDROID_PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Guide explaining how to build and sign a production Android App Bundle for Play Store submission.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Gitignore file for Android project directories, build outputs, keystores, and IDE metadata.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Explains Android keystore purpose and cautions not to store actual keystore files in the repository.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration defining app metadata, web directory, allowed navigation hosts, Android settings, and splash screen options.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles with OKLCH theme variables for light/dark mode and standardized component styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the CivWorld root div and main frontend entry script.
frontend/scripts/android-build.sh: Shell script automating web build, Capacitor sync, and Android debug/release builds with safety checks.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the main app layout, routing structure, and Internet Identity initialization, including profile checks and Capacitor II shim installation.
Implements a window.open override to route Internet Identity authentication through the Capacitor Browser plugin.
frontend/src/capacitor/README.md: Provides build instructions and prerequisites for running the app on Android using Capacitor.
frontend/src/capacitor/runtime.ts: Provides safe platform-detection utilities for determining Capacitor, Android, or iOS environments.
frontend/src/capacitor/TROUBLESHOOTING_I: Explains common Internet Identity login issues on Android and how to diagnose them.
frontend/src/components/AnalyticsDashboa: Displays analytics metrics and top posts using fetched analytics data with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Renders user badges with tooltip support, size variants, and optional truncation.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Implements a fixed bottom navigation bar with icon-based routing and active-state styling.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Provides a chat interface showing message history, user details, auto-scrolling, and message sending.
frontend/src/components/CreateDiscussion: Modal component providing a form to create a discussion with title, context, region, and category, submitting via useCreateDiscussion.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupModal: Modal for creating a group with name, description, and optional cover image upload using useCreateGroup.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPostM: Modal for posting text or an optional image to a group, handling previews and upload progress before submitting via useCreatePost.
frontend/src/components/CreatePollCard.t: Empty file with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostCard.t: Component for creating a general post with text, optional image or video uploads, validation, and submission through useCreatePost.
frontend/src/components/EditPostModal.ts: Modal for editing an existing post, allowing text, image, and video updates with validation and upload handling via useUpdatePost.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: Modal for editing user profile fields and saving updates through query hooks.
frontend/src/components/EditProfilePictu: Modal for uploading, validating, previewing, and saving or removing a profile photo with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header handling navigation, authentication actions, search, notifications, and profile access.
frontend/src/components/HorizontalNav.ts: Horizontal navigation bar switching between discussions, polls, and constituency pages.
frontend/src/components/PollCard.tsx: Placeholder file with no implemented component.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a post with likes, comments, sharing, author details, and post management actions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Initial profile setup modal that collects basic user info and saves a new profile.
frontend/src/components/QuickPostBar.tsx: Component for creating posts with text, image, or video, handling file validation, previews, identity checks, and submission via useCreatePost.
frontend/src/components/ReportModal.tsx: Modal for reporting posts, comments, or profiles, allowing users to select a reason, add details, and submit via useSubmitReport.
Displays trending hashtags with shimmer refresh animation and navigation or callback handling on hashtag click.
frontend/src/components/VerifiedBadge.ts: Renders a checkmark badge with tooltip indicating a verified account, supporting multiple sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's identity and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading stored identities and handling login/logout flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating posts, profiles, reports, and other backend data using the actor instance.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme color variables, dark mode values, and global interaction/selection behaviors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePagePage.tsx: Provides a form for creating a new page with images, metadata, and validation, but currently only simulates submission.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePollPage.tsx: Implements a poll creation form with option management, validation, and backend mutation via createPoll.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays a feed of discussion posts with a post creation card and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Shows a coming-soon interface for political events and campaigns with descriptive feature previews.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Provides an explore interface with trending posts, active groups, and analytics tabs using computed data.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Displays a group's details, members, posts, and join/create-post actions, loading all related data via queries.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Shows all groups and the user's groups with tab switching, plus actions to create groups or pages.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders public and news feeds with filtering, sorting, and admin/verified-only news post creation.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Allows starting a chat by entering a Principal ID and displays a chat window once selected.
frontend/src/pages/MyConstituencyPage.ts: Provides a form to submit local issues and displays constituency issues and political promises.
frontend/src/pages/PagesPage.tsx: Placeholder pages section with navigation to create new pages.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Displays a list of polls with filtering, voting functionality, and mock category/region metadata.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the logged-in user's profile, posts, badges, and editing options with modals.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileView.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/ReelPage.tsx: Placeholder page indicating upcoming short-form video (reels) features.
frontend/src/pages/SharePage.tsx: Provides UI for creating posts and shows coming-soon sections for events and video uploads.
frontend/src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: Displays posts matching a specific hashtag and allows starting a discussion.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Shows another user's profile with follow/unfollow, reporting, and their posts.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPage.tsx: Placeholder page displaying a coming-soon video feed message.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and enums for user profiles, posts, comments, polls, messages, groups, notifications, analytics, issues, discussions, reports, and education types.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Provides functions to format backend errors into user-friendly messages and detect authentication or system readiness errors.
frontend/src/utils/candidOption.ts: Contains utilities for normalizing and validating media content fields for Candid serialization.
frontend/src/utils/profilePhotoValidatio: Validates, crops, compresses, and produces previews for uploaded profile photos.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles URL parameter extraction, session persistence, and safe removal of parameters from hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, plugins, and content scanning paths.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature state, requirements, and pending feature requests for navigation updates.
